body:
Seat registration post for `domain:ui` **seat 2** @ objectui. Job description: `objectstack:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. The body is authoritative; the title and assignee are derived views. Only the sitting seat PM writes it. Body refreshed 2026-10-02T02:59Z at the stand-down (seat vacant), after seventeen landings (round 1). The previous revision (the stand-down write of session `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) is the archive for sections 2–4, which carry over unchanged.

## 1. Current PM

| | |
|:--|:--|
| status | ⏳ **vacant.** Signed off 2026-10-02T02:59Z on the maintainer's word in session chat, verbatim: 「你可以下班了」. Successor: `/pm-dispatch ui 2`, after reading this post and the stand-down brief (the final comment). The brief is the release marker, so a successor may take the seat at once. |
| previous occupant | GitHub account `os-sales`, session `session_01JG2jy8a9su7ia4Hx7zxv42`, seated 2026-10-01T13:47Z. **Seventeen landings** this round (see section 2). It left nothing in flight: no dev or review subagent running, no open PR of this seat, no cloud dev session (every dev ran as a subagent), and no `pm:dispatched` card assigned to `os-sales`. The hourly Routine `trig_0146NkrbAV8DqGWP3BLJi7ra` is **deleted**. |
| maintainer ruling (contract-review faces) | 「我已经同意了，不需要严格的规则」, given in this session's chat on 2026-10-01. `.changeset` / CHANGELOG prose is checked by the seat in its ACCEPT, sentence by sentence against the diff, with no isolated `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` subagent. The isolated at-tier review stays on `Clause-②: yes`, `packages/spec/src/**` and governed text. The skill text change is filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#21187. |
| stance (lapsed with this session) | 「准备发版本，暂时只处理 p0 p1 p2 的卡」: a release was being prepared, so only `priority:p0` / `p1` / `p2` cards were taken. Like every stance, it lapsed when this session signed off. A successor asks the maintainer again. |
| handover ledger: lane queue at sign-off | `domain:ui` @ objectui: 37 open cards (6 `pm:queue`, 2 `pm:dispatched`, 18 `pm:on-hold`, 5 `pm:blocked`, 1 `pm:epic`, 5 with no `pm:*` state). **The one p2 in `pm:queue`: objectui#10859.** Its remainder, after triage's answer `5944767525`: (ii) the 28 keys, where the seat applies the maintainer's standing criterion key by key ("does the mainstream have it?": yes gives it a reader, no retires it), and only unsettled keys go to the box as ONE batch decision card; (iii) the 30 keys plus 9 unclear keys, which need the seat's ruling (ruling `5861220023`), measured first. The ratchet `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` stands at 66 and never rises. The other 5 `pm:queue` cards are p3, including objectui#11434 (the unread-designer-member settlement split off #10859, with a TS-required fork to measure). |
| handover ledger: decision box, findings, other seats | Decision box (`needs-user-decision`, this lane): empty. Ungraded `finding` in objectui: objectui#11432 (the `ru` two-slot plural family close-out, filed by this seat). Another `domain:ui` seat is active on account `os-elon-musk` (p3 cards objectui#11417 / #11423 dispatched). |
| handover ledger: cross-lane memos | the cloud seat owns objectui#11403's last Acceptance line: a hosted tenant registers `dist/sdui.manifest.json` after cloud's next `.objectui-sha` move, and cloud's Dockerfiles must build with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, not `vite build`. objectstack-ai/objectstack#21251 (the showcase's `object-metric` `filter` records) and #21229 (`exportOptions`) are with objectstack triage. The `@objectstack/spec` bump that carries objectstack-ai/objectstack#20882 owes the `object-grid` `description` move into the bag (objectui#11276's ACCEPT). The pointer on objectui#5250 (`5941938792`) is for PR objectui#11069's census. |
| charter | `check-harness-current.mjs`: CURRENT at objectstack `origin/main` `fbcc05f400` when seated. |
